name: github-cli
description: Use the GitHub CLI to inspect and manage repositories, issues, pull requests, releases, and workflows.

interface.shortDescription: Inspect and manage GitHub from Codex.
interface.longDescription: Use the installed GitHub CLI for authenticated repository work. Read-only inspection is the default; external writes require an explicit request in the current task.
defaultPrompt: Use $github-cli to inspect this GitHub repository.
Use $github-cli to review open pull requests.
Use $github-cli to summarize recent repository activity.
